_comment: §6.6.7's minimum test-vector set. Read by both PersianNormalizationVectorsTests.swift (Swift) and Tools/data-pipeline/tests/test_normalize.py (Python) so the two implementations of canonical()/matchKey() can never silently drift apart. Each row is written with explicit \u escapes for ZWNJ/ZWJ/combining marks so the exact codepoints are unambiguous in a plain-text diff.

vectors.note: می‌خواهم: internal ZWNJ kept by canonical, stripped by matchKey
میخواهم: no ZWNJ present, identical either way
کتاب‌ها: internal ZWNJ kept by canonical, stripped by matchKey
خانهٔ: ه + combining hamza above (U+0654, a diacritic) -> matchKey drops the diacritic
١٢٣: canonical maps Arabic-Indic -> Persian digits, matchKey -> ASCII
Hello: canonical is case-preserving, matchKey lowercases Latin
don’t: matchKey normalizes the curly apostrophe to a straight one
